results.name: Cable Low Seated Row
instructions: Sit on the pulldown machine with your feet placed securely under the knee pads. Grasp the bar with both hands, hands at shoulder-width apart and palms facing down.
Sit upright with your back straight and core engaged, extending your arms fully in front of you.
Pull the bar towards your lower abdomen, bringing your elbows back and squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Slowly extend your arms back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your back straight throughout the exercise to avoid strain.
Engage your core to maintain stability and proper posture.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation and reduce the risk of injury.
results.description: Cable Low Seated Row is a beginner multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the lats (back). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Biceps, Shoulders, Lower Back.

results.name: Cable Lying Extension Pullover (With Cables Attachment)
instructions: Attach both cable handles to a single low pulley. Lie on a flat bench with your head positioned near the pulley. Grasp the handles with your palms facing up and your arms extended in line with your body.
Keep your feet flat on the floor and your back pressed against the bench. Engage your core to maintain stability.
Raise the handles in an arc motion over your head, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Lower the handles back to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep a slight bend in your elbows throughout the exercise to reduce strain on your joints.
Focus on the contraction of your lats and triceps as you pull the handles up.
Exhale as you pull the handles back to the starting position and inhale as you lower them.
results.description: Cable Lying Extension Pullover (With Cables Attachment) is a beginner single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the lats (back). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Chest.

results.name: Cable One Arm Bent Over Row
instructions: Attach a single handle to a low pulley on a cable machine. Stand facing the machine, holding the handle with your left hand. Step back with one foot to create tension in the cable.
Bend at the hips slightly to the floor, keeping your knees bent and your back flat. Place your right hand on your right knee for support.
Pull the handle towards your lower abdomen, bringing your elbow back. Focus on squeezing your shoulder blade towards your spine.
Slowly extend your arm back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to your right hand.
tips: Exhale as you pull the handle towards you and inhale as you extend your arm back.
Start with a lighter weight to ensure proper form and gradually increase the resistance as you build strength.
Focus on the contraction of your back muscles as you pull the handle towards you.
results.description: Cable One Arm Bent Over Row is a beginner multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the lats (back). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back, Biceps.

results.name: Cable One Arm Lat Pulldown
instructions: Sit at the lat pulldown machine with your feet flat on the floor and knees secured under the pads. Grasp the handle attached to the high pulley with your right hand, arm fully extended above you, palm facing forward.
Pull the handle down towards your right shoulder, bringing your elbow down while slightly leaning back.
Slowly extend your arm back to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to your left hand.
tips: Exhale as you pull the handle down and inhale as you extend it back.
Focus on squeezing your shoulder blade towards your spine as you pull down.
Maintain a neutral wrist position to prevent strain.
results.description: Cable One Arm Lat Pulldown is a beginner multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the lats (back). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back, Shoulders, Biceps.

results.name: Cable Palm Rotational Row
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, facing the cable machine. Attach a single handle to a middle pulley and hold it with your right hand, palm facing downwards.
Bend slightly at the hips and knees, keeping your back straight, and extend your right arm forward.
Pull the handle towards your body, rotating your palm to face upwards as you bring your elbow back, keeping it close to your torso.
Slowly extend your arm back to the starting position, rotating your palm back to face inwards. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to your left hand.
tips: Focus on squeezing your back muscles at the top of the movement.
Use a lighter weight to ensure proper form and gradually increase the resistance as you get stronger.
Exhale as you pull the handle towards your body and inhale as you extend it back.
results.description: Cable Palm Rotational Row is a beginner multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the lats (back). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Biceps, Shoulders, Forearms.

results.name: Cable Pull in Kneeling
instructions: Stand in a half-kneeling position with the cable pulley beside you. Hold the handle with your left hand, palm facing forward, while the right leg is positioned forward for stability.
Keeping a slight bend in your elbow, pull the handle downward and inward toward your hip, by driving your elbow toward your side.
Pause briefly while squeezing your back muscles at the end of the movement.
Slowly return your arm to the starting position with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching sides.
tips: Keep your torso upright and avoid rotating during the movement.
Squeeze your lats and rear shoulder at the bottom of each repetition.
Move through a controlled range of motion without using momentum.
Inhale as you return to the starting position and exhale as you pull the handle inward.
results.description: Cable Pull in Kneeling is a beginner multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the lats (back). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Biceps, Upper Back, Core.

results.name: Cable Pulldown (Pro Lat Bar)
instructions: Sit at the cable pulldown machine with your feet flat on the floor and knees secured under the pads. Grasp the Pro Lat Bar attached to the high pulley with an overhand grip, hands placed wider than shoulder-width, arms fully extended above you.
Pull the bar down towards your upper chest, bringing your elbows down and back while keeping them close to your body.
Slowly extend your arms back to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Exhale as you pull the bar down and inhale as you extend it back.
Keep your elbows close to your body and avoid flaring them out.
Use a lighter weight to ensure proper form and gradually increase the resistance as you get stronger.
results.description: Cable Pulldown (Pro Lat Bar) is a beginner multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the lats (back). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back, Biceps.

results.name: Cable Pulldown
instructions: Sit at the cable pulldown machine with your feet flat on the floor and knees secured under the pads. Grasp the bar attached to the high pulley with an overhand grip, hands placed at shoulder-width, arms fully extended above you.
Pull the bar down towards your upper chest, bringing your elbows down and back while keeping them close to your body.
Slowly extend your arms back to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Exhale as you pull the bar down and inhale as you extend it back.
Keep your elbows close to your body and avoid flaring them out.
Use a lighter weight to ensure proper form and gradually increase the resistance as you get stronger.
results.description: Cable Pulldown is a beginner multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the lats (back). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back, Biceps.

results.name: Cable Pushdown (Straight Arm)
instructions: Stand facing the cable machine with a straight bar attached to the high pulley. Grasp the bar with both hands, palms facing down, and place your hands shoulder-width apart.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, keeping your back straight and a slight bend in your knees.
Push the bar down towards your thighs, keeping your arms slightly bent throughout the movement.
Slowly return to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Exhale as you push the bar down and inhale as you return to the starting position.
Stand with a slight bend in your knees for better stability.
Focus on engaging your lats during the movement.
results.description: Cable Pushdown (Straight Arm) is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the lats (back). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Core, Triceps.

results.name: Cable Rear Pulldown
instructions: Sit at the cable pulldown machine with your feet flat on the floor and knees secured under the pads. Attach a straight bar to the high pulley and grasp the bar with both hands, palms facing forward, hands wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lean your head slightly forward, keeping your back straight and core tight. Extend your arms fully above your head.
Pull the bar down behind your neck by bending your elbows and bringing them down to the sides.
Slowly extend your arms up to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your back straight and avoid using momentum.
Focus on squeezing your shoulder blades together at the bottom of the movement.
Exhale as you pull the bar down and inhale as you extend it back up.
results.description: Cable Rear Pulldown is a beginner multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the lats (back). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back, Biceps.
